subject.title: feat(memory-core): optional cross-encoder rerank stage for memory search

question: Should OpenClaw add this public `MemoryRerankProvider` plugin API and `memoryRerankProviders` manifest contract for builtin memory search, with v1 as a single exclusive slot and qmd excluded?
rationale: The code path is reviewable and tested, but accepting a new public SDK/manifest contract is a durable product/API compatibility decision that automation should not make.

options.title: Accept This Seam After Rebase
options.body: Approve the generic builtin rerank-provider contract, resolve current-main conflicts, and land the tested implementation with the concrete reranker plugin left separate.

options.title: Narrow The Contract First
options.body: Ask the author to adjust the API shape, gating mechanism, slot semantics, or qmd scope before merge while preserving the current implementation work where possible.

options.title: Reject Or Defer Core SDK Surface
options.body: Close or pause this PR if maintainers prefer a ClawHub plugin-only path or a different remote-reranker design instead of a new core SDK seam.

recommendation.title: Accept This Seam After Rebase
recommendation.body: Approve the generic builtin rerank-provider contract, resolve current-main conflicts, and land the tested implementation with the concrete reranker plugin left separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the public plugin SDK and memory/plugin architecture boundary, where the strongest current history points to steipete.
